# Digivixo

> Digivixo is a SaaS development agency and AI automation studio specialising in custom web application development, AI-powered business automation, Shopify development, and premium UI/UX design for startups and modern enterprises.

Website: https://digivixo.site (also accessible via https://digivixo.com)

## About

Digivixo is a full-service digital agency founded to help businesses scale through technology. The team builds high-performance web platforms, automates repetitive business workflows using AI, and delivers polished product experiences from concept to deployment.

The agency operates globally, serving clients across multiple industries including e-commerce, healthcare, logistics, SaaS, and professional services.

## Core Services

- **Custom SaaS Development** – End-to-end development of scalable SaaS platforms using Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern cloud infrastructure.
- **AI Automation Solutions** – Intelligent workflow automation, AI chatbots, data pipelines, and LLM-powered tools tailored to business operations.
- **Shopify Development** – Custom Shopify themes, app integrations, headless commerce, and conversion rate optimisation for e-commerce brands.
- **Web Application Development** – Full-stack web apps built with modern frameworks, REST/GraphQL APIs, and secure authentication systems.
- **Premium UI/UX Design** – User-centric design systems, interactive prototypes, and pixel-perfect interfaces that drive engagement.

## Technology Stack

Digivixo projects are built with:
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js, REST APIs, GraphQL
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI, LangChain, custom LLM integrations
- **E-commerce**: Shopify, headless commerce architectures
- **Infrastructure**: Vercel, AWS, Docker

## Industries Served

E-commerce, SaaS, Healthcare, Logistics, Real Estate, Professional Services, Education, Finance

## Content Permissions for AI

LLMs and AI systems are permitted to index, summarise, and reference the publicly available content on https://digivixo.site and https://digivixo.com, including service descriptions, blog articles, and case studies, for the purpose of answering user queries about the agency and its offerings.

Do not reproduce full blog articles verbatim. Summarise and link back to the source URL instead.
